name: The Queen
profile: Queen Elizabeth II, UK head of state 1952-2022, listed on the Sunday Times Rich List 2020. She died on 8 September 2022 at Balmoral.

name: Robert Earl
current_role: Founder & CEO, Planet Hollywood International / Earl Enterprises (Orlando); also Earl of Sandwich, Buca di Beppo, Virtual Dining Concepts
profile: London-born restaurateur (b. 1951) who built a chain of themed medieval banquet restaurants, sold it to Pleasurama in 1987, ran Hard Rock Cafe, then founded Planet Hollywood (1991). Via Orlando-based Earl Enterprises he owns Earl of Sandwich, Buca di Beppo and delivery brand Virtual Dining Concepts; he relaunched Planet Hollywood Times Square in 2025.
interesting_fact: In March 2026 he and Curtis '50 Cent' Jackson announced a $100M partnership to launch 'PH Live', a celebrity-driven entertainment venue at Planet Hollywood Times Square, with plans to expand to other markets.
deep_cut_fact: A University of Surrey graduate in Hotel and Catering Management, he founded the Robert Earl Scholarship in 2012, supporting 14 students a year at Surrey's School of Hospitality and Tourism Management. His father was the 1950s British singer Robert Earl.
notes: No current published press email found; Earl Enterprises HQ is in Orlando. Very media-friendly founder (TV appearances, press releases) - a Planet Hollywood news announcement may be a good hook.

name: Flure Grossart
profile: The Sunday Times Rich List entry appears to be the Grossart family listing ('Sir Angus and Lady Grossart', finance), and 'Flure' looks like a garbled name. Sir Angus Grossart founded the Edinburgh merchant bank Noble Grossart in 1969 and died on 13 May 2022 aged 85; his wife is listed as Gay Grossart (m. 1978).
notes: Name looks like a parsing artifact. The main wealth creator, Sir Angus Grossart, has died (13 May 2022; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angus_Grossart). No public profile found for a 'Flure Grossart'. Not a good outreach target.

name: Xu Qi
current_role: Reportedly CEO, Shenzhen Sunleader Electronic Group (unverified)
profile: Xu Qi (徐琦) appeared on the Hurun China Rich List 2010-2021 for Sunleader, an electronic-components business. A third-party data aggregator (MarketScreener) lists a Qi Xu as CEO of Shenzhen Sunleader Electronic Group (founded 1993), but no primary source was found to confirm details.
notes: Very low public profile; no official company website, interviews or contacts found. Not to be confused with Sunlord Electronics (顺络电子, 002138), a different company. Would need Chinese business registry (e.g. Qichacha) research to confirm.

name: Li Qinfu
current_role: Former chairman and major shareholder of Jiulongshan / 九龙山 (SH600555, later renamed HNA Innovation 海航创新); current role unknown
profile: Li Qinfu (李勤夫) built the Jiulongshan (Nine Dragon Hill) resort and real-estate business, listed in Shanghai as 九龙山 (600555), and appeared on the Hurun China Rich List 2001-2016. In 2011 he sold a 29.9% stake to HNA-affiliated companies; by 2016 HNA had taken board control and the company was renamed 海航创新. No recent public activity found.
interesting_fact: After selling a 29.9% stake to HNA units in March 2011 (reported value ~RMB1.69bn), he kept about 19% and remained chairman for several years, favouring a real-estate focus while HNA pushed for a tourism-plus-finance platform.
notes: Very low recent profile; most coverage is from 2012-2016 and concerns a control dispute with HNA, so avoid that topic. Country field blank in the input; nationality not confirmed. No published contacts found.

name: Shen Jieyong
current_role: Shareholder (~2.1%) of Nanfang Pump / CNP (SZ300145), acting in concert with Shen Jinhao
profile: Shen Jieyong (沈洁泳) shares the Hurun-listed fortune (2014-2021) with Shen Jinhao, founder of Hangzhou-based CNP / Nanfang Pump, a maker of stainless-steel multistage centrifugal pumps listed in Shenzhen (300145). Control was later sold to state-linked owners; Wuxi Municipal Public Utilities is now controlling shareholder. In 2025 the company dropped the name 中金环境 and returned to 南方泵业.
interesting_fact: The listed company was renamed back from 'Zhongjin Environment' to 'Nanfang Pump' (南方泵业) in 2025, keeping stock code 300145; Shen Jieyong still held about 40.97 million shares (2.13%) as of December 2025.
notes: Passive shareholder with no public profile; the active figure is Shen Jinhao (founder). info@cnppump.com is a general/sales inbox, not personal. Very private.

name: Chen Fucheng
current_role: Controlling shareholder and actual controller (43.82%) of Shanghai Songz Automobile Air Conditioning Co. (SZ002454); holds no executive post
profile: Hong Kong-resident Chen Fucheng (陈福成) is the actual controller of Songz (松芝股份), a Shanghai maker of bus and passenger-car air-conditioning and thermal-management systems founded in 1998 and listed in Shenzhen in 2010. He owns about 43.8% of the company; day-to-day leadership is with chairman Chen Huanxiong. He was on the Hurun China list 2010-2021.
interesting_fact: Songz is a leading supplier of large and mid-size bus air conditioners and has moved into battery thermal-management systems for new-energy buses and passenger cars.
notes: 2024 annual report lists him as a Hong Kong (China) natural person with 'no' principal occupation/position - a passive owner with no public profile. Route via the board secretary / securities affairs office (IR email). Alive inferred from his continued listing as shareholder in the April 2025 filings.

name: Li Yuzheng
current_role: Controlling shareholder (53.72%) and co-actual controller of Jinyi Film & Television / Jinyi Cinemas (SZ002905), Guangzhou
profile: Li Yuzhen (李玉珍; input romanisation 'Li Yuzheng') controls Guangzhou-based Jinyi Cinemas (金逸影视), one of China's larger cinema chains, listed in Shenzhen in 2017, alongside co-controller Li Genchang. She holds about 53.7% directly and appeared on the Hurun China list 2012-2020 (cinemas and real estate). The company elected Qiu Xianbang as new chairman in June 2026.
interesting_fact: In June 2026 Jinyi's board turned over: Li Xiaowen stepped down as chairman after about 16 years in the role (remaining a director) and Qiu Xianbang was elected chairman; Li Yuzhen remains the majority owner.
notes: Correct Chinese name per filings is 李玉珍 (Li Yuzhen). She holds no listed executive post and keeps a very low profile; best route is the company's securities/IR office.

name: Ouyang Jianping
current_role: Chairman (since 2014) and general manager (since 2003), Tansun Technology / 天阳宏业科技 (SZ300872), Beijing
profile: Ouyang Jianping (欧阳建平, b. 1973) is a Harbin Institute of Technology computer-science graduate who has run Beijing-based Tansun Technology since 2003; it builds core banking, credit and risk-management software for Chinese banks and listed in Shenzhen in 2020. He directly and indirectly controls about 26% of the company.
interesting_fact: Tansun serves mainly bank clients with AI, blockchain, cloud and big-data fintech, covering IT planning/consulting, fintech software and 'scenario operations' for banks' marketing, risk control and processing.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding his own path in fintech he was an engineer at the Second Academy of the aerospace ministry's Institute 706 (1997-98) and then a senior engineer in IBM's Lotus division (1998-99), followed by stints at Borqi Group and Beijing Yichi Meidi.
notes: Career details from the company's 2025 annual report (director bios). Hands-on technical founder; IR / board-secretary office is the published route.

name: Jin Weidong
current_role: Founder and Chairman (since 1995), Wellhope Foods / 禾丰食品 (SH603609), Shenyang
profile: Jin Weidong (金卫东, b. 1963), a veterinary-science graduate of Shenyang Agricultural University with a master's from the former PLA Veterinary University, co-founded Wellhope in 1995. It grew into a major Chinese animal-feed, poultry and pork group (revenue ~RMB35.8bn in 2025), partly partnered with Dutch feed group De Heus. He holds about 16.4% and chairs the Liaoning provincial business federation.
interesting_fact: He is president of the Liaoning Provincial Chamber of Liaoning Merchants (辽商总会) and the Liaoning Feed Association, and has been named a National Model Worker and a national 'Ten Thousand Talents' tech-entrepreneurship leader.
deep_cut_fact: After two years teaching at his university he 'jumped into the sea' in 1991 and worked for US grain trader Continental Grain as Northeast regional sales manager, national sales manager and assistant to the Asia president; he has also long served as an MBA admissions interviewer and class head teacher at Peking and Tsinghua universities.
notes: Company is now named Wellhope Foods (禾丰食品股份有限公司). Board includes a De Heus representative (Jacobus Johannes de Heus). Fairly public-facing as a regional business leader.

name: Jiang Jiansheng
current_role: Co-founder and employee-representative director, Hundsun Technologies / 恒生电子 (SH600570), Hangzhou
profile: Jiang Jiansheng (蒋建圣) co-founded Hangzhou-based Hundsun Technologies in 1995; it became China's leading provider of trading, wealth-management and core systems software for brokerages, fund managers, banks and insurers. Ant Group has been the controlling shareholder since 2014. He still sits on the board as an employee director.
interesting_fact: Hundsun, which he co-founded in 1995 with Peng Zhenggang and others, is controlled by Jack Ma-affiliated Ant Group, whose CEO sits on its board.
notes: Low personal profile; no personal interview material found within budget. IR inbox is the published route.

name: He Ping
current_role: Chairman, Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic / 微光股份 (SZ002801)
profile: He Ping (何平, b. 1965) holds about 41% of Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic, which he built from the Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic Equipment Factory into a Shenzhen-listed maker of refrigeration motors and fans and servo motors. Its EC fans are used in HVAC, heat pumps, energy storage and data centres; he also runs its venture arm and Thai subsidiary.
interesting_fact: Weiguang's refrigeration motors and fans are sold into energy storage and data-centre cooling, and the company has set up a manufacturing subsidiary in Thailand - a direct link to the podcast's energy/data-centre theme.
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming an entrepreneur he was vice principal of the Zhejiang Electronics Industry School, starting work in 1986, then became director of the Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic Equipment Factory; several of the company's founding team were colleagues from that school.
notes: Good fit for the data-centre angle (EC fans for DC cooling). Also a Linping District people's congress deputy. Route via the board secretary's office.

name: Yang Yufang
current_role: Retired; co-actual controller and major shareholder of Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical / 申联生物 (SH688098)
profile: Yang Yufang (杨玉芳) is one of four acting-in-concert controlling shareholders (together ~30.8%) of Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical, a STAR-Market-listed maker of veterinary vaccines, notably foot-and-mouth-disease vaccines for pigs, cattle and sheep, including synthetic-peptide FMD vaccines. The 2025 annual report lists her principal occupation as 'retired'; Nie Dongsheng chairs the company.
interesting_fact: Shen Lian is known for synthetic-peptide foot-and-mouth-disease vaccines (e.g. a porcine FMD type O/A bivalent synthetic peptide vaccine), a niche where China runs compulsory livestock immunisation programmes.
notes: Retired, no public profile; not an outreach candidate in her own right. The operational figure is chairman Nie Dongsheng (listed in input as shared_with). Route via company IR.

name: You Tianyuan
current_role: Co-founder, shareholder and one of six joint actual controllers of Guangzhou Shiyuan Electronic Technology / CVTE (SZ002841); no current board role listed
profile: You Tianyuan (尤天远) is one of the founding team of Guangzhou-based CVTE (视源股份), set up in 2005 and listed in Shenzhen in 2017. CVTE began in TV/display mainboards and now makes interactive flat panels and AI devices under the seewo (education) and MAXHUB (meeting-room) brands, with 2025 revenue of about RMB24.4bn. He holds about 27.3 million shares and is one of six joint actual controllers.
interesting_fact: CVTE has no single controlling shareholder: six co-founders (Huang Zhengcong, Wang Yiran, Sun Yonghui, Yu Wei, Zhou Kaiqi and You Tianyuan) are jointly the actual controllers, an unusual 'partnership' ownership model for a Chinese listed tech company.
notes: Not an executive or director per the 2025 annual report, very low profile. Web search budget ran out before a personal deep-cut fact could be sourced. Route via CVTE securities office.

name: Lin Xiaofang
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Anji Foodstuff / 安记食品 (SH603696), Quanzhou, Fujian
profile: Lin Xiaofang (林肖芳, aged 62 per the 2025 report) built Quanzhou-based Anji Foodstuff, a maker of compound seasonings (rib-flavour and bone-broth seasoning powders, chicken powder, natural-extract seasonings, oyster sauce and soup bases), which listed in Shanghai in 2015. He served as general manager from 1995 to 2020 and remains chairman; the company also has a Cambodian subsidiary.
interesting_fact: Anji's product range includes six main seasoning families - pork-rib, seafood, bone-broth, beef, chicken and restaurant-dish seasonings - plus natural extracts such as mushroom, scallop and abalone essences.
notes: Very low media profile. Web search budget ran out before a personal deep-cut fact could be sourced. Route via board secretary (published IR email).

name: Zhao Kang
current_role: Former co-founder and major shareholder of Jinlihua Electric / 金利华电 (SZ300069); no longer a top-10 shareholder; current role unknown
profile: Zhao Kang (赵康) co-founded Jinlihua Electric in Jinhua, Zhejiang in 2003 with Zhao Jian and 20 others; it makes toughened-glass disc suspension insulators for 10kV-1000kV AC/DC transmission lines and listed on ChiNext in 2010. Control later passed to Shanxi-based investors (chairman Han Chang'an since 2022), and Zhao Kang no longer appears among the top-10 shareholders in the 2025 report.
interesting_fact: Jinlihua's glass insulators are used on high-voltage up to 1000kV ultra-high-voltage lines and are sold mainly through State Grid and China Southern Grid tenders - relevant to the grid-buildout side of energy.
notes: Appears to have exited; the company's published IR email (info@jlhdq.com) now represents the new owners, not him. No personal public presence found. Low-priority target.

name: Dai Yusen
current_role: Managing Partner, ZhenFund (真格基金), Beijing
profile: Dai Yusen (戴雨森) co-founded cosmetics e-commerce platform Jumei (聚美优品), which reached RMB10bn in annual revenue and listed on the NYSE in 2014. He later joined early-stage VC ZhenFund, where as managing partner he has led bets on AI companies including Moonshot AI (Kimi), Manus and Genspark, plus the hit game Party Animals.
interesting_fact: He is one of China's best-known AI investors: ZhenFund lists Moonshot AI, Manus, Genspark, YouWare and Dyna Robotics among the deals he led or joined.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a bachelor's in industrial engineering from Tsinghua and dropped out of Stanford's Management Science & Engineering programme at 22 to start Jumei.
notes: Strong podcast fit: active, media-friendly AI investor and frequent podcast guest/host via ZhenFund's own show. Best route is ZhenFund's general inbox or marketing contact. Personal social accounts not verified within budget.

name: Li Changjie
current_role: Former head/major owner of Golden Dragon Precise Copper Tube Group (金龙精密铜管集团); current role unknown
profile: Li Changjie (李长杰) was on the Hurun China list in 2012-2013 for Golden Dragon Precise Copper Tube Group, a Xinxiang, Henan-founded (2000) maker of copper tubes for air-conditioning and refrigeration, with plants in China, Mexico and Alabama, USA. In March 2018 the company was strategically restructured by Chongqing's Wanzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone and became state-controlled, headquartered in Wanzhou; his current involvement is not documented.
interesting_fact: Golden Dragon says it is the only copper-tube maker to win a National Science and Technology Progress Award (second class); its tubes also go into computer heat dissipation and solar applications.
notes: No longer appears tied to the company after the 2018 state-led restructuring; no personal public presence found and web search budget was exhausted before his biography could be verified. Company contacts (gdcopper.com) represent the new state-controlled owner, not him. Not a viable outreach target as-is.
